dict.Deschide pânza de desen cu stiloul ales;: Opens the drawing canvas with the chosen pen; the drawing goes into the note and stays editable (✎ on it)
dict.Editează desenul (liniile se pot muta, ș: Edit the drawing (strokes can be moved, erased or added to)
dict.Redeschide desenul cu liniile lui: le po: Reopens the drawing with its strokes: you can move, erase or add to them
dict.Reluare: desenul se redesenează linie cu: Replay: the drawing is redrawn stroke by stroke, in the order you made it
dict.Notița ca pagină web într-un singur fiși: The note as a single-file web page (.mht), with the pictures inside: opens in a browser and in office programs that read .mht
